items.question: What are your opening hours?
items.answer: We are open Monday to Friday from 7:30 AM to 6:00 PM, with full-day and half-day places available.

items.question: Which ages do you care for?
items.answer: We welcome children from 6 months to 5 years, with an after-school club for ages 5 to 8.

items.question: Are your teachers trained and certified?
items.answer: Yes. Every teacher holds an early childhood qualification, current first-aid training and a background check.

items.question: What does a typical day look like?
items.answer: A balanced mix of play, learning projects, creative time, outdoor play, healthy meals and rest, all in a calm routine.

items.question: How do you keep children safe?
items.answer: Secure entry, careful supervision, age-right activities and clear health and safety routines that we review every term.
